# spiffe — SPIFFE workload identity

[All groups](README.md)

## spiffe id

Validate a SPIFFE ID against the SPIFFE ID specification and show its trust domain and path.

MCP tool: `spiffe_id`.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--id` | string | e.g. spiffe://example.org/ns/prod/sa/web. **Required.** |

Plus the [common parameters](README.md#common-parameters).

## spiffe svid

Check an X509-SVID (PEM chain) or JWT-SVID against the SPIFFE specifications: one SPIFFE URI SAN, leaf and CA constraints and key usage, chain to the trust bundle; or JWT algorithm, kid, sub, audience and expiry with the signature verified against the bundle's JWT authorities.

MCP tool: `spiffe_svid`.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--svid` | string | PEM certificate chain or a JWT-SVID (CLI: @file or - for stdin). **Required.** CLI: `@path` reads a file, `-` reads stdin. |
| `--bundle` | string | Trust bundle: SPIFFE bundle JSON, a JWKS, or PEM CA certificates. May be a file path (CLI or profile only). |
| `--trust-domain` | string | Trust domain of the bundle; default from the SVID. |
| `--audience` | string | Audience a JWT-SVID must carry. |
| `--expected-id` | string | SPIFFE ID the SVID must assert. |

Plus the [common parameters](README.md#common-parameters).

## spiffe bundle

Fetch (from a bundle endpoint) or read a SPIFFE trust bundle and describe its X.509 and JWT authorities, sequence number and refresh hint; check every key's use and kid and each authority's validity.

MCP tool: `spiffe_bundle`.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--trust-domain` | string | Trust domain, e.g. example.org. **Required.** |
| `--endpoint` | string | Bundle endpoint URL (https_web profile). |
| `--bundle` | string | Bundle content instead of an endpoint. May be a file path (CLI or profile only). |

Plus the [common parameters](README.md#common-parameters).

## spiffe fetch

Ask a SPIFFE Workload API (SPIRE agent, etc.) for this workload's X509-SVIDs and trust bundles, and optionally a JWT-SVID for an audience; check every SVID against the specifications and the bundles it came with.

MCP tool: `spiffe_fetch`.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--socket` | string | Workload API address, e.g. unix:///run/spire/agent.sock (default env SPIFFE_ENDPOINT_SOCKET). |
| `--audience` | string | Also fetch and check a JWT-SVID for this audience. |

Plus the [common parameters](README.md#common-parameters).
